examples: Do you help with motor insurance?
intents.answer:
Yes. We arrange comprehensive and zero-dep policies from leading insurers at the showroom. Multi-year options are available with new car delivery.

For accidents: Our body shop handles denting, painting and cashless claims with empaneled insurers. Bring FIR / claim intimation and policy copy.

intents.name: service-schedule
examples: Which service does my car need if I purchased it on a given date?
How much does a Midsize Sedan periodic service cost?
intents.description: Periodic service schedule based on purchase date
intents.answer:
Please provide your purchase/delivery date and current odometer reading. We map this to the schedule:
- ~1 month / 1,000 km: 1st free inspection/PDI (Fluid levels, tyre pressure, basic health check)
- ~6 months / 10,000 km: 1st periodic service (Engine oil + filter, inspection, top-ups)
- ~12 months / 20,000 km: 2nd periodic service (Oil & filter, air filter, brake & underbody)
- ~18 months / 30,000 km: 3rd periodic service (Oil & filter, cabin/air filter, suspension & battery)
- ~24 months / 40,000 km: 4th periodic/major check (Oil, spark plugs, coolant, brake fluid)
- Every 6 months / 10,000 km thereafter: Ongoing periodic service
- Any time after accident/warning light: Repair/diagnosis visit

intents.name: eco-tips
intents.description: Provide eco-driving and car care advice
intents.answer:
• Warm up gently — avoid high RPM for the first 1–2 km after a cold start.
• Smooth throttle and early upshifts save fuel; hard acceleration and late braking waste it.
• Keep tyre pressure at the door-sticker PSI — under-inflated tyres cut mileage and raise wear.
• Remove unused roof racks and heavy boot clutter; extra weight and drag reduce economy.
• Use AC wisely — recirculate after cabin cools; park in shade when possible.
• Follow the service schedule on time — clean oil, filters and plugs keep combustion efficient.
• Prefer the recommended grade of engine oil and genuine filters for best economy and emissions.
• Idle less than 30–60 seconds when waiting; switch off if safe and legal for longer stops.
• Plan routes to avoid peak congestion when you can; steady 40–60 km/h city speeds are kinder on fuel.
• Check PUC, battery terminals and coolant level monthly; fix warning lights promptly.
• Wash with pH-neutral shampoo; avoid harsh chemicals on paint and plastic trims.
• For long trips, check tyre pressure cold, top up washer fluid, and carry a basic tool/kit.

intents.name: loan-finance
examples: Can I buy a car on a loan?
What is the EMI for a Swift?
intents.answer: Yes, we arrange car loans through partner banks and NBFCs with interest starting at 9.25% per year and tenure up to 7 years. Our finance desk handles the full process. Example EMIs (Rs. 6L loan/5yrs): Swift ~Rs. 10,500/mo. Example EMIs (Rs. 5L loan/5yrs): WagonR ~Rs. 8,750/mo. Example EMIs (Rs. 10L loan/5yrs): Creta ~Rs. 17,500/mo.

intents.name: car-loan-emi
examples: What is the EMI for WagonR?
intents.answer:
• WagonR (₹5L loan, 5 yrs): ~₹8,750/month
• Creta (₹10L loan, 5 yrs): ~₹17,500/month
Longer tenures up to 7 years can lower EMIs.

intents.name: car-loan-eligibility
examples: Who is eligible for a car loan?
intents.answer: Age: 21-65 years. Minimum monthly income: ₹25,000. Credit score of 700+ helps secure better rates.

intents.name: car-loan-interest
intents.answer: Interest starts at 9.25% per year. Final rate depends on credit profile and chosen bank.

intents.name: car-loan-tenure
examples: How many years can I take a loan?
intents.answer: You can take a car loan for 1 to 7 years. Shorter tenure = higher EMI/less interest; Longer tenure = lower EMI.

intents.name: car-loan-documents
intents.answer:
Salaried: Aadhaar, PAN, Address Proof, Last 6 months bank statements, Last 3 months salary slips.
Self-Employed: Aadhaar, PAN, Address Proof, Last 6 months bank statements, Last 2 years ITR.

intents.name: car-loan-down-payment
examples: How much down payment do I need?
intents.answer: Minimum down payment is 15% of the on-road price. Higher down payments reduce the loan amount and monthly EMI.

intents.name: car-loan-prepayment
examples: Can I close my loan early?
intents.answer: Yes, after paying 6 EMIs. A foreclosure charge of up to 3% of the outstanding amount may apply, depending on bank policy.

intents.name: car-loan-approval-time
examples: How much time does loan approval take?
intents.answer: Usually takes 1 to 2 working days after submitting all documents. Our finance desk updates you at every step.

intents.name: exchange-car
examples: Can I exchange my old car?
How much exchange bonus do I get?
Which documents are needed for exchange?
intents.description: Information about exchanging old cars for new ones
intents.answer: Yes, Velocity Motors accepts old cars of all brands in exchange. You receive an evaluated value plus an exchange bonus up to Rs. 25,000 (depending on the new model). Evaluation takes 30-45 minutes at the showroom. Required documents: RC book, insurance copy, ID proof, and NOC if there is a running loan.

intents.name: delivery-info
keywords: when will I get my car
intents.description: Details on delivery timelines, process, and home delivery
intents.answer: Delivery typically takes 2-4 weeks after booking, though high-demand models like Thar or Defender may take longer. On delivery day, we complete inspection, payment, paperwork, and a feature demo. Home delivery within the city is available free of charge upon request. You will receive the invoice, insurance policy, warranty booklet, and service coupons; RC is issued by RTO later.

intents.name: service-maintenance
examples: How many free services do I get?
Do you provide pickup and drop?
intents.description: Service schedules, costs, pickup/drop, and AMC details
intents.answer: New cars come with 3 free services (at 1k/1mo, 5k/6mo, 10k/12km). After that, service every 10,000 km or 12 months. Paid service starts at Rs. 3,999 for hatchbacks and Rs. 5,499 for SUVs. Workshop hours: Mon-Sat, 9 AM - 7 PM. We offer free pickup/drop within 10 km. We use 100% genuine spare parts. AMC starts at Rs. 11,999 for 2 years.
